title: D365 Knowledge Search (Demo)
description: Demo — published Dynamics 365 knowledge articles with static sample data.

props.text: How to apply a credit memo to an outstanding invoice
Step-by-step guide for locating a credit memo in the system and manually applying it to reduce the invoice balance.
Password reset and account portal access troubleshooting
Covers self-service reset, admin-forced reset, MFA issues, and browser cache clearing for portal login failures.
Delivery delay escalation — process and customer communication template
When to escalate a delayed shipment, which team to contact, and approved language for notifying the customer.
Billing dispute resolution — identifying duplicate charges
How to pull billing history, identify duplicate billing cycles, and initiate a refund or adjustment through the finance portal.
SLA compliance — Tier 1 first-response and resolution timeframes
Defines SLA targets by priority (High: 1hr / Normal: 4hr), breach consequences, and how to request an SLA pause.
